weekly_review.summary:
Review window: September 29 through October 9, 2026; previous retained review September 29.
Issuance: MS / Lima, Campbell, Tirupattur et al. (October 1) reports about $466bn AI credit YTD through September 30 and $23bn in September, versus $216bn FY2025. The prior August 20 vintage was $445bn / $217bn. Its $500-550bn full-year forecast remains dated August 20 and is not reconfirmed; the new $25-30bn ABS/CMBS forecast is a subset.
Proposals: WSJ October 7 via Vital Knowledge / Crisafulli reports OpenAI-Broadcom ~$50bn and SpaceX-NVIDIA ~$40bn financing talks, plus unsized Oracle chip financing. MS / Tyler et al. October 8 explicitly has no Oracle company response or deal. These are not committed funding or incremental completed issuance.
Execution: Applied Digital October 7 release confirms an October 1 ready-for-service milestone: another 75MW critical IT, taking Polaris Forge 1 to 250MW. Its $1.59bn 7% ELN-04 notes closed June 16 per the 10-Q; the new ledger row is historical backfill. RFS does not establish GPU delivery or cloud-service commencement.
Older disclosure checks: NVIDIA August 26 10-Q confirms a conditional $105bn SB Energy guarantee for ~4.25GW IT, not the whole up-to-8GW campus. Oracle September 11 10-Q confirms ATM completion ($19.9bn net) and $11.4bn financing-component customer prepayments already inside $23.1bn operating cash flow; do not add prepayments to that cash-flow total. These are reconciliations of old events, not October cash inflows.
Watchpoints: MS / Tyler and Guerrero September 30 Lighthouse timing risk remains a forecast dispute, not confirmed delay. Oracle September 16 disclosure and the PSC new docket support a September refiling, not final approval. Jefferies / Titu October 9 flags the rate/funding constraint. Next checks: financing closings, collateral and guarantees; Lighthouse approvals; utilization after APLD RFS; current Anthropic filing/IPO status.
Coverage limits: reviewed wiki graph/pages, full-corpus search, five selected full Outlook messages and relevant primary disclosure sections; linked broker PDFs were not separately read. Outlook date filtering returned older matches, so dates were screened manually; this is not an exhaustive mailbox audit. Individual project-bond marks and sovereign-AI issuance remain unconnected. August relative-spread, loan and appetite observations remain historical. AVGO September 2 and SPCX September 25 watchpoints remain unresolved in this review.
